title: Whispers from the Abyss
description:
Thrilled to finally unveil this project! It's been 8 months of hard work, traveling to a new country, and learning a lot. Today, I'm proud to share my latest demo reel, crafted during my Mentorship at Think Tank Center. Huge thanks to the school for giving me the chance to do the mentorship in Vancouver. It's been an amazing journey, meeting new people and learning from them. Special shoutout to Jon Catapia, lead build TD at DNEG, for his guidance in improving my skills and bringing this project to life.
This project is inspired on the movie 'Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest' and serves as a visual representation of Davy Jones' quarters, featuring his distinctive piano as a focal point.
